biography.value: Stone Titans are the point at which Stone Nephilim become effectively unkillable through mundane means. DR 8 plus Stone Skin plus regeneration plus immunity to non-magical piercing and slashing means conventional weapons accomplish nothing meaningful. Seismic Authority immediately Restrains as many enemies as possible; Continental Fist removes priority targets from the engagement through Engulfing. A summoner who calls one has effectively ended the question of whether the physical fight can be won.

system.attacksNotes:
Continental Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 damage (11 + 7 Str).
  • Margin 2: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled + Prone + Restrained; ongoing 16 bludgeoning damage per round; no save; Fortitude save (Hard task, 2 successes) each round to break free.
  • Margin 3: 22 damage + immediately Engulfed (driven into ground); Blinded + Restrained + 24 bludgeoning damage per round; Might [Hard] check as full [Combat] action to escape, or ally excavates over 3 [Interact] actions.

World Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120/240 ft, 15-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 18 bludgeoning damage (15 + 3 Dex) + Prone.
  • Margin 2: 18 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 18 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned; all creatures within 15 feet take 12 bludgeoning damage from shockwave.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Immovable: Cannot be knocked Prone or moved. Earth Bond: While on natural earth or stone, regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Powerful Build: Stone Titan counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Stone Grip: Creatures Grappled by the Stone Titan add 4 to both dice on Athletics, Acrobatics, and Might checks to escape. Seismic Authority (1/day) [Combat]: Strikes the ground once. A 60-foot diameter seismic event occurs. All non-designated creatures on natural ground make Fortitude [Hard] saves. Failure: 32 bludgeoning damage + Prone + Restrained for 1 minute; ally must spend 2 [Interact] actions digging them out or they succeed on a Might/Acrobatics [Hard] check as a full [Combat] action. 1 success: 16 damage + Prone only. Piercing and Slashing Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 2 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical piercing and slashing damage while within 30 feet. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 12. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Stone titan fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.
